list.comment: Enhanced hero section with video background: added video fallback functionality for reduced motion preferences, introduced responsive hero controls, and refined styles for improved consistency and accessibility.

task.summary:
Add initial project setup with homepage and assets
- Included `index.html` as the main structure for the webpage. - Added `favicon.svg` for site branding. - Uploaded coffee-related SVG files for logos. - Structured sections for navigation, menu, about, and Instagram feed in `index.html`.

Responsive navigation and UI improvements: enhanced mobile menu interactions, added accessibility features (skip links, aria labels), subtle theme/overlay effects, hero blur overlays, polished typography, and refined button hover states.
Responsive typography and layout tweaks: improved About section readability, feature alignment, and responsive behavior across breakpoints; refined footer and mobile styles for consistency.
Responsive grid layout for features: replaced flexbox with CSS Grid for better alignment and responsiveness; adjusted typography and spacing for various screen sizes.

Refined typography and layout: improved readability with modular scale-based typography, updated headings for consistency, and adjusted spacing for better alignment across sections; introduced CSS Grid for features and optimized contact/info card styles for responsiveness.

Refined menu content and visuals: updated menu items, prices, and descriptions; introduced consistent aspect ratios for images; enhanced contact card styles across themes; improved page layout with responsive adjustments and sticky map.
Added new images for menu items in `imgs/lc` directory (afrique, bleu, decaf, monaco).

Enhanced hero section: replaced pseudo-element background with inline image for improved LCP; added scroll cue animation; optimized mobile layout and viewport handling; introduced JS fallbacks for CSS effects.
Enhanced hero section: updated background image, added custom scroll cue, optimized layout for mobile, and adjusted styles for improved performance.

Responsive navigation overhaul: improved mobile menu functionality, added advanced animations and accessibility features (ARIA states, keyboard support), refined styles across breakpoints, and optimized layout transitions.

Refined mobile and responsive experience: replaced hero background with modern `<picture>` implementation, optimized image loading with WebP and eager priorities, simplified navigation animations for better performance, and deferred interactive map to improve initial load.
Lightened hero overlay for small screens, improved responsiveness with modern viewport units, and updated background gradients for enhanced visual clarity.
Simplified image handling by removing `<picture>` elements and WebP sources; transitioned to PNGs for hero, menu, and about section images; ensured consistency across visuals.

Enhanced hero section with video background: added video fallback functionality for reduced motion preferences, introduced responsive hero controls, and refined styles for improved consistency and accessibility.
